A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an end to end solution for facial soft biometrics detection on mobile phones, that is both computationally efficient and highly accurate.

we propose a computationally efficient CNN model, which is able to simultaneously estimate a set of facial soft biometrics from face images, and is capable of real-time implementation on low-power devices.

the proposed architecture can be deployed on a mobile device, while achieving comparable performance to the state of the art.
